site_map.text:
# Twin item-return bodies

Each row contains 264 bytes of bank data followed by a 492-byte body. The bank
words, symbol and section spelling, and layout are unchanged. Both whole-row
baselines and final candidates match all 189 words. The first body starts at
0x8015E908, within row base 0x8015E800. The twin subtracts 0x6000 from local
addresses. The complete retail body was read; see retail.dis.

## Roles and complete control flow

The frame is 0x20 bytes, with ra/s0/s1 saved. Register s0 holds origin, then the
occupied count or shared-result pointer; s1 holds actor. The function queries a
neighbor slot from origin XY and actor direction/elevation. Success copies the
source word into the shared slot, clears the source and returns the slot address
in v0. Otherwise it queries a target; null returns zero.

For the distinguished target, a condition helper decides whether to proceed.
Count 20 nonnull slots, take a random remainder, reject empty/forbidden/flagged
entries, copy the selected entry to the shared slot, invoke the removal helper,
and return the shared slot address. For any other target, reject empty/flagged
entries, copy and clear its word at +0x48, and return the shared slot address.

All exits join 0x8015EADC: restore ra/s1/s0/sp, then jr ra and nop. This sequence
does not change v0. The old final noreturn pseudo-call names this local epilogue.
The existing v0 is the shared-slot address, not either pseudo-call argument.

## Controlled source changes

The first shared symbol is 0x80162FE4 = 0x80160000 + 3065 * 4. Its twin is
0x8015CFE4 = 0x80160000 - 3079 * 4. Direct declared symbols replace the two later
literal-page calculations and their keeps. The last block returns its slot
pointer through the existing s32 interface. No new constraint is introduced.

The first branch's existing keep and page calculation remain. Using the natural
symbol there moved the shared store into the jump delay slot in place of the
source clear. This is an unresolved scheduling dependence, not impossibility.
The return-only control misses eleven register substitutions: target in a0
versus retail a1, plus shared-page/item-word role changes. Direct shared symbols
restore those roles. Retaining the first block makes the complete row exact.

Two original loop bindings remain. Individual erasures change register roles or
instruction count; six erasures across the twins yield no additional removals.

## Attribution and interface limits

The stock 2.8.0 recipe is unchanged. The whole-row fingerprint reports insufficient
evidence because decoding starts in bank data and stops early. Running the same
scan on the actual 123-word body finds an allocated split store and two stores
in local-jump delay slots, consistent with the CDK/2.8 family. No unique historical
release is established. The a1 return copy alone does not override store evidence.

The interface remains s32(void *, void *). Existing pointer-to-word return casts
remain; no narrowing or signature trick was introduced. The previously valid
return paths already return this slot word or zero; the last target path now does
so too, matching retail v0. A current DUNGEON C search found no direct references
to the two actual body entries or synthetic row names outside their own files.
That does not prove absence of indirect callers. No external helper contract
changed. The unchanged bank-data prefix remains separate from this C-pin repair.

independent_review.text:
# Independent review: twin item-return candidates

Verdict: no semantic or constraint blocker found for `func_80E9D000_final.c` or `func_80EA3000_final.c`.

The only functional edits are the intended ones. Each candidate removes the synthetic local-epilogue declaration/call, uses the already-declared shared-slot symbol in the two later store paths, returns that slot through the existing `s32` result, and removes three `ASM_KEEP` sites. The old pointer-to-`s32` return transport is unchanged. The first literal-page path and its keep remain, as do the two existing `ASM_REG` bindings. No signature, type, section, bank initializer, compiler recipe, or new constraint changes. This review makes no claim that indirect callers are absent.

The shared addresses are exact: `0x80160000 + 3065 * 4 = 0x80162FE4`, and `0x80160000 - 3079 * 4 = 0x8015CFE4`. The retail last path loads the item word, forms the corresponding shared address in `v0`, stores the word, clears `target+0x48` in the jump delay slot, and enters the restore-only epilogue. Replacing the fake jump with `return (s32)shared_slot` therefore preserves the retail return value. The common epilogue does not modify `v0`.

The 264-byte data prefix is unchanged; the reviewed body is the following 123 words. Current `strict.json` records linked-strict 189/189 whole-row matches with zero substitutions, indels, positional words off, or relocation masking for both twins. It binds directly to final/current source hashes `acb7370849fd75e76a014744431c9bebac577c814fe5ae438fff93466759afc5` and `80db96ed6ee511b3b0b4098e7f640fffbc7d8bc6d716d1bf5df6547ff5d81f85`. Each production source is byte-identical to its corresponding `*_final.c`; both 756-byte covering-window checks in `gates.json` also report `MATCH`.

The negative controls are discriminating. `return_only.c` misses 11 register substitutions; `direct_shared.c` is a four-indel store/jump reorder. The three typed erasures per twin all fail (slot rotation, one-word length drift, and register rename), leaving exactly one keep and two register constraints in each final source.

This was a read-only source and artifact review; no compile was run here. The supplied strict, covering-gate, and host-syntax results cover the current candidate files.

routing_report.text:
# R49 in-row jump routing

This bounded read-only refinement rechecked the R47 inventory against current sources, current rowbase resolutions, and the unchanged retail binary. `func_818B15F4` is excluded because it is now landed and pin-free. The two twin sources `func_80E9D000` and `func_80EA3000` changed during the refinement and no longer declare or call their former in-row `noreturn` targets, so they are also excluded from the still-current totals; their current hashes are recorded in `routes.json`.

A target is an epilogue only when decoding from that exact address reaches `jr $ra` using only register/stack restores or moves, with the return delay slot included. A later return elsewhere is not evidence. Exact byte-bearing snippets for all targets are in `routes.json`.

The 56 current targets classify as **16 straight-line epilogues**, **40 internal control-flow targets**, and **0 undecided**. At row level, there are 7 epilogue-only, 9 mixed, and 13 internal-only rows.

5 current rows carry data before their compiled body. Their measured prefixes are recorded per row; every audited target lies after its prefix, so no data word was treated as an instruction target.

## Small epilogue-only routes

| Row | Bytes | Pins | Target |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `dungeon/func_8182D698` | 404 | 3 | `func_80025010` |
| `dungeon/func_819A764C` | 520 | 5 | `func_80025038` |
| `dungeon/func_818B78E8` | 744 | 1 | `func_800253B0` |
| `dungeon/func_8195F0BC` | 896 | 6 | `func_80024C08` |
| `dungeon/func_819C0C18` | 1336 | 1 | `func_80026924` |

These five are routing leads only. The classification does not prove a source repair, pin removal, or impossibility result.

## Marked negatives

`dungeon/func_81844F2C` and `dungeon/func_8195AB84` remain marked prior negatives and are excluded from the lead list. Their bytes also confirm non-epilogue local entries: the former is mixed (`func_80024808` branches internally; `func_80024860` returns), while both targets in the latter perform constructor/loop work.

The JSON binds this result to the current inventory, retail, rowbase, source, and per-row retail-slice SHA-256 hashes.

If conflict, STOP and report the specific instruction evidence; an exact pinned baseline does NOT refute a fingerprint. No recipe changes. Up to six meaningful source probes, about four minutes. Explain one causal prediction per probe, frame/roles first; stop after two unexplained stalls. Full verifier summary owns lengths; regions only locates residuals. No assembly, new pins, volatile, fake use, literal-page replacement constraints, pointer narrowing, signature tricks or backend modifications. Preserve semantic operations and caller contracts. Existing fake-call arguments are not evidence of actual helper interfaces. Save each candidate and full verifier output, then compact REPORT.md with hashes, precise result, semantic caveats and next discriminating action. Partial reduction is useful only if whole-row exact. Do not call it landable.

No production source/config/ledger/git edits, shared exports/gates, network, credentials or other agents. All rg --max-filesize 4M and narrow paths; never search repo root, work root or home recursively. Do not read campaign history. Baseline and six probes are the entire compile budget.
